about: Answer views in a reply (ADR 264, #1623): a ```ui fence holds a JSON tree of the catalog's components (lib/ui-catalog.json); the apps read it with one generic validator driven by the catalog (public/answer-view.js, test/answer-view.test.js; the Android app reads the same cases in its own ticket). `cases`: `source` is what the fence holds (with `repeat`, its `mark` replaced by `with` written `times` times), then either `drawn`, the normalised view `{ alt, root }` with only what was read (defaults are the drawing's own, a value that was cut or left out is not there), or `refused`, why the fence is drawn as code, with `alt`, what could be read of the fence's alt for the quiet line above the code (an empty text without one). `problems` lists what was left out or cut and where (`at` is the node's path, `prop` the prop inside it), in the order it was met; a case without it has none. `replies`: a reply's Markdown (`done` is false while it is still being written, true when it has ended; true when not given) and `parts`, in order: `text` (Markdown between the fences), `view`, `code` (a fence drawn as code with its `alt` and why), and `drawing` (a fence still being written: the reply shows "Drawing a view…" and waits). `sends`: what a view posts as the owner's next message (ADR 265): `view` is a drawn tree, its nodes counted by `path` (the root is `0`, its children `0.0`, `0.1`, …); `values` holds what the owner changed, by the path of the input (a text, a number, a pair for a range, a list for a multi-select, or a boolean); `posts` is the form's message, or `presses` the message of each button by its path. A rule changes here and in every app together.
